title: 第3章 出殡第4章 气血境修士之威王武之死
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 很快，便到了第二天。
今天是六月十八，宜祭祀、入殓、安葬、破土。
也就是李家老家主李玄风入土为安的日子。
清晨，旭日东升，金灿灿的阳光遍洒大地。
青枫谷内，早已是人声鼎沸。
所有的李家族人齐聚在青枫谷内，披麻戴孝，送老家主最后一程。
与此同时，青枫谷外。
不速之客不期而至。
邹家家主望着眼前瑰丽的青枫谷，眼中掠过一丝贪婪。
“很快，这个地方就属于我了。”
对于青枫谷这块风水宝地，他觊觎很久了。
灭了李家后，若能占据此处，休养生息。
若干年后，说不定邹家便是下一个白河县的顶尖豪强。
为了保证这次的行动能够万无一失，四大势力的精锐可谓是倾巢而出。
其中，光是肉身境修士就有二十余人。
再加上隐藏在暗中伺机而动的苏云，足以覆灭任何一个没有气血境修士坐镇的家族。
一路畅通无阻，没有遭遇任何阻拦。
很快，他们就来到了李府外。
门口，有两名锻体境的黑衣武士把守。
一看就来者不善的众人立马引起了守卫的警惕。
其中一人，上前拦住了众人。
大声道：“各位，此乃青枫李氏所在，未得主家同意，不得入内。”
大刀门门主闻言，哈哈一笑：“那我倒要看看你们能不能拦住我了。”
说完。
不待守卫反应过来。
大刀门门主悍然出手，极快的身法窜射而出，一掌重重的轰在了守卫的胸膛上。
可怜守卫才锻体境的实力，如何抵御一位肉身大成的强者？
巨大的力道当场将守卫轰飞了出去，撞开了大门，砸入了院中，滑出了几米远。
另一名守卫反应过来。
一脸愤怒的抽出了手中的兵刃：“大胆......”
话还未说完。
也步了前者的后尘。
随意解决了两只拦路虎，大刀门门主拍了拍手，看着头顶上金色的【李府】二字，眼中闪过一丝愤恨和不屑。
随后才一脸淡然的道：“诸位，可以进去了。”
身后的众人这才反应过来。
虽然他们联合在一起是为了对付李家。
content_en:
Soon, it was the next day.
Today is June 18th, which is the time to offer sacrifices, enshrine, bury and break the ground.
That was the day when Li Xuanfeng, the old head of the Li family, passed away to rest.
In the early morning, the rising sun rises in the east, and the golden sunshine shines all over the earth.
The Qingfeng Valley was already filled with people.
All the Li family members gathered in Qingfeng Valley, wearing sackcloth and mourning, to bid farewell to their old family leader.
At the same time, outside Qingfeng Valley.
Uninvited guests arrive unexpectedly.
The head of the Zou family looked at the magnificent Green Maple Valley in front of him, with a trace of greed in his eyes.
"Soon, this place will be mine."
He has been coveting the Feng Shui treasure land of Qing Maple Valley for a long time.
After destroying the Li family, if you can occupy this place, you can rest and recuperate.
A few years later, maybe the Zou family will be the next top powerhouse in Baihe County.
In order to ensure that this operation was foolproof, the elites of the four major forces came out in full force.
Among them, there are more than twenty monks in the physical realm alone.
Coupled with Su Yun who is hiding in the dark and waiting for opportunities, it is enough to destroy any family without a Qi and Blood Realm monk.
The journey was smooth and no obstacles were encountered.
Soon, they arrived outside Li's residence.
The door was guarded by two black-clothed warriors in the body-forging realm.
At first glance, everyone seemed to be in bad company, which immediately aroused the guard's vigilance.
One of them stepped forward to stop everyone.
He said loudly: "Everyone, this is the residence of the Qingfeng Li family. No one is allowed to enter without the consent of the owner."
Hearing this, the master of Dadao Sect burst out laughing: "Then I want to see if you can stop me."
Finished.
Without waiting for the guard to react.
The master of the Dadao Sect took action brazenly, shooting out with extremely fast movements, and struck the guard's chest heavily with his palm.
How can the poor guard with the strength of the body-forging realm resist a strong man with a great physical body?
The huge force knocked the guard away on the spot, knocked open the door, smashed into the courtyard, and slid out several meters away.
Another guard reacted.
With an angry look on his face, he drew out the weapon in his hand: "Bold..."
The words are not finished yet.
Also followed in the footsteps of the former.
After casually dealing with the two roadblocks, the master of the Dadao Sect clapped his hands and looked at the golden word "Li Mansion" above his head, with a trace of resentment and disdain flashing in his eyes.
Then he said calmly: "Everyone, you can go in."
Only then did everyone behind him react.
Although they joined together to deal with the Li family.
